Returning to Allah, Islamic Spiritual Se.intro: Ten booklets by Dr. Yusuf Al-Qalb on returning to Allah, from remembrance, patience and du'a to gratitude, purifying the heart, trust and contentment, ending with a night-time companion for the Muslim soul. Numbered 1 to 10.

The Meridian Sequence.intro: A three-book science-fiction series by Eleanor Hart following astronomer Dr Lena Kasra and the crew of the survey ship Meridian as they trace an impossible signal and approach first contact. Best read in order.

Dr Claire Shaw series.intro: A psychological mystery series by Anna Wray, set in West Yorkshire and following Dr Claire Shaw, where clinical observation meets hidden truths. Three books so far.

The Living Shia Tradition.intro: A wide-ranging collection by Dr. Saiyed Ali Al-Razavi exploring Twelver Shia Islam as a living faith, a historical tradition, and a contemporary way of life.
about: Bringing together accessible guides, historical studies, devotional resources, family guidance, and analysis of modern challenges, the series introduces readers to the beliefs, practices, institutions, memories, and questions that continue to shape Shia Muslim communities around the world.

The books in this collection examine subjects as varied as raising Shia children in Western societies, understanding the beliefs and daily practices of Twelver Shia Islam, discovering the meaning and structure of popular supplications, tracing the history of azadari from Karbala to the present day, explaining Shia identity to a wider audience, and considering the future of religious leadership in the Shia world.

Written for both Shia and non-Shia readers, The Living Shia Tradition combines clarity, depth, and contemporary relevance. Each title stands independently and may be read in any order, while together they offer a richer understanding of how the legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt continues to inform worship, identity, family life, scholarship, community, and public thought.
This series is for readers seeking not only to learn what Shia Muslims believe, but also to understand how those beliefs are remembered, practised, transmitted, and lived today.

The Roads Not Taken.intro: What might have been? When is it too late to begin again? How much of life do we lose waiting for it to start?
about: The Roads Not Taken is a collection of standalone novels by Julian Vale about ordinary people at the moment everything shifts. A woman finds seven doors, each opening onto a life she could have lived. A clockmaker can mend every clock but his own, stopped the day his son left. A bride-to-be boards a night train with a letter her mother never sent. An old couple tend their garden while the young man across the street learns what they're planting in him.
Each book is complete on its own, so start anywhere. Together they explore memory, regret, second chances and the small choices that shape a whole life.
For readers of The Midnight Library, A Man Called Ove and The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry.
